title: folder-sync kept version, version 1
description: A kept version is one object, <root>_history/<project>/<host-id>/<path>/<version>, holding the file's exact bytes. It has no JSON body and no custom metadata: everything about it is in its key and in its LastModified, which is when it left the folder. This schema describes a kept version as a reader parses it from a listing (the API's history and deleted routes answer these fields). See docs/CONTRACT.md, 'History'.

key.description: <root>_history/<project>/<host>/<path>/<version>; at most 1,024 bytes (R2's key limit). A path whose key would be longer is published but never kept (was.why = key_too_long).

root.description: The account root, '' for a v0 bucket-key folder.

written_at.description: The version id's first half: the manifest entry's written_at, truncated to the millisecond. Absent for an unlisted version.

sha16.description: The version id's second half: the first 16 hex digits of the bytes' sha256. Absent for an unlisted version.

unlisted.description: true when the object was not the version the manifest listed (the copy's If-Match answered 412): it is kept under <its LastModified>_unlisted, and is never restored without its bytes being checked.

left_at.description: The object's LastModified: when this version left the folder. The retention schedule reads only this.

version_id.description: <written_at, UTC, to the millisecond>_<sha16>, or <LastModified, UTC, to the millisecond>_unlisted. Sorts oldest first. WHY a colon: no published path may contain ':' (names.CheckWindows, webhost.checkWebPath), so a version name can never be a file or folder of the published tree.
